name: Solomon
bio: Solomon was a son born to David in Jerusalem, first named simply among his many brothers (2 Samuel 5:14) — the child who would grow up to inherit David's throne, build the temple the LORD promised through Nathan, and become Israel's most celebrated king for his wisdom and wealth. His rise to the throne, his reign, and his legacy unfold in detail across the rest of Samuel, 1 Kings, and 1-2 Chronicles.
